title: Enterprise Ask Bento: automated bundling + rapid-scope playbook for Sales/CS feature intake
creator: Liam O'Connor
description:
Problem: Sales and Customer Success are sending a high volume of non-bug enterprise feature asks (compliance toggles, VPC networking, SSO edge-cases, bespoke routing policies). Each ask often requires similar discovery steps (customer constraints, data residency, expected QPS, SLA requirements, cost tolerance) but triage today is manual and inconsistent. That causes slow response times, duplicated scoping effort, and missed bundling opportunities across accounts.

Proposal: Build a lightweight "Bento" intake + playbook that: (1) automatically groups similar asks into bundles (by vertical, capability, and compliance constraint), (2) emits a one-page rapid-scope for each bundle with cost/effort band, risk flags, and next-step recommendation, and (3) provides a standardized handoff artifact for Eng/Design with linked artifacts (templates for PRDs, design mocks, and evaluation hooks). The first MVP is a procedural playbook + a set of automations in the intake form (tags + heuristics) and a Google Sheet / Confluence renderer.

Goals: accelerate Sales/CS first-response to <48h for initial signal, reduce duplicated scoping by 40% across similar asks, and produce a reliable data artifact for PM/Eng prioritization (bundle-level impact score).
acceptance_criteria: Automated bundling: intake form + tag heuristics group >= 75% of identical asks into bundles without manual reassignment
Rapid-scope artifact: generated one-page scope for a bundle including (summary, customer list, top-3 constraints, cost/effort band, risk flags, recommended next step)
Handoff template: Eng/Design checklist and links appended to each scope artifact (Confluence page + Drive folder stub)
Playbook published: Sales/CS quick-runbook + example responses and canned follow-ups available in Confluence
Measurable outcome: first-response time from Sales/CS to PM <= 48h for pilot cohort and duplication of scoping work reduced by >=40% after 6 weeks
steps: Sprint 0: interview top-10 Sales/CS reps and gather 40 recent asks (samples)
Define bundling rubric: axes = capability (API/console/infra), vertical (finance/healthcare/saas), regulation (PII/residency), and scale (QPS/SLA)
Prototype automations: intake form field constraints + a Google Apps Script that clusters rows using heuristics
Create rapid-scope template in Confluence and a Drive folder template generator
Run 4-week pilot with 6 Sales reps and 3 enterprise accounts; collect metrics and feedback
Iterate and propose production automation (webhook -> Redwood intake service) and Eng work package for scale
